title: How Are You
description: "how are you?" in electric-blue bitmap type on grey, four times over, each line more broken than the last. Drag a line down and its pixels drop out and slip a cell at a time; drag up and it heals; scrub across to wear it away and hold still to mend it.
intent: Decay as a stepped, physical property of a real pixel grid: each glyph is rasterised to cells, and every cell owns a fixed threshold for dropping out or slipping one cell, so wear is monotonic and reversible.
sources: herb reference board: 4090d1d5 "how are you?" electric-blue bitmap type decaying line by line
